def transform(grid):
    # Locate the rectangular zero mask and retrieve its replacement from
    # the corresponding position in the 180-degree repeated background.
    zeros=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==0]
    r0=min(r for r,c in zeros); r1=max(r for r,c in zeros)
    c0=min(c for r,c in zeros); c1=max(c for r,c in zeros)
    h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    return [[grid[len(grid)-1-(r0+i)][len(grid[0])-1-(c0+j)] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
PY

def transform(grid):

    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
